objective: Repair the post-integration semantic-audit residue in src/agent-tools.mjs and test/readable-paths-complete.test.mjs. Keep the correct root traversal and readAdmitted filtering. Complete the regression suite so list_files, search, and direct read are exercised wherever each test vector requires them. Explicit in-territory out-of-scope list/search bases must return structured refusals without echoing the requested private base or exposing protected names, lines, or bytes. Source and tests must settle together.
constraints: For omitted-path and dot-root traversal, assert both list_files and search succeed, return admitted public observations, and omit every private observation.
For directory admission and exact-file admission, construct separate toolsets and assert list_files, search, and direct read expose exactly the admitted descendants or file.

For an explicit private base, call both list_files and search; assert each response is structured JSON and contains neither the requested base name nor any protected filename, matching line, or bytes.
For unrestricted compatibility, exercise readablePaths omitted and readablePaths empty with list_files, search, and direct read.
Use a unique temporary directory and always retire it with test cleanup.
Do not edit outside the two focus paths.

given: public/match.txt and private/secret.txt contain the same search token
testVectors.when: list_files and search run with path omitted
list_files and search run with path dot
then: dot is accepted as root traversal
list and hits contain only admitted descendants

given: one toolset admits public and another admits exact file public/a.txt
testVectors.when: list_files, search, and direct read exercise both toolsets
then: exact-file admission exposes and reads only public/a.txt
direct read rejects public/nested/b.txt under exact-file admission
forbidden: exact-file admission exposing a sibling, descendant, or ancestor

given: private/secret.txt exists and contains a matching token
testVectors.when: list_files and search use explicit base private
then: both return structured JSON errors stating only that the path is outside declared readable scope

given: one toolset omits readablePaths and another supplies an empty array
testVectors.when: list_files, search, and direct read execute through both toolsets
then: both toolsets preserve unrestricted legacy behavior for all three operations
forbidden: different behavior between omitted and empty readablePaths
